purpose: Distinguish useful action-specific uncertainty from penalty magnitude, redundancy with actor-distance, and limited decision-event precision
predefinition_scope: Definitions fixed after known aggregate development and confirmation conclusions, before this audit inspects further detailed development outcomes. Post-hoc exploratory analysis, not independent confirmation.
independent_sampling_unit: Starting episode, not individual candidate actions or action pairs; two development batches share one trained checkpoint
value_target: Q of the current frozen deterministic actor: candidate action first, then the same frozen actor until the remaining finite horizon, with gamma .98 and no terminal bootstrap
value_precision: Previously saved deterministic simulator continuations with float64 state/reward accumulation and float32 actor deployment; no conditional Monte Carlo sampling error, but not exact real arithmetic or a certified oracle
stochastic_return_rule: Reject inputs with stochastic-policy/dynamics or Monte Carlo replications; a single sampled stochastic return must not be treated as true expected Q
critic_target_caveat: Q1 is compared with current frozen-policy continuation; its smoothed lagged TD-target policy can differ, so this is not a uniquely attributable optimization error

errors.signed_error: Q1 - saved frozen-policy continuation value; positive means Q overestimation relative to this target
errors.candidate_regret: maximum saved value in this state's finite candidate bank minus this action's saved value

signals.u: Frozen calibrated twin-min one-step TD-residual width, not a Q1-error guarantee
signals.actor_distance: mean over four coordinates of squared distance from the same frozen actor's action; geometry only

primary_descriptive_metric: Equal-state mean of defined within-state Pearson correlations between U and signed Q1 error
partial_correlation_definition: Center U, signed error, and actor-distance within a state; remove each centered vector's least-squares linear projection on centered actor-distance from both U and signed error; correlate the two residual vectors
partial_correlation_claim_scope: Additional linear within-state association only, not causal independence, complete information conditional on distance, or a new fitted selection method
correlation_undefined_rule: Constant input or constant actor-distance makes the corresponding correlation/partial correlation undefined. Partial residual L2 at or below 1e-12 of its original centered vector L2 is undefined. Record reasons and counts, never replace undefined correlations by zero.
pair_tie_rule: Each quantity's action difference is tied if abs(x_i-x_j) <= tie_atol + tie_rtol*max(abs(x_i),abs(x_j)); signal and outcome ties are counted separately
pairwise_rule: All unordered candidate pairs per state. A signal agrees with an error contrast if their differences have the same sign, among pairs with neither quantity tied. Average defined correctness fractions equally across states; never use pair count as independent sample count.
best_candidate_rule: First candidate within tie_atol + tie_rtol*abs(maximum saved value) of that maximum, using the unchanged stable bank order; record the full near-best set and ambiguity
decision_facing_contrast: For raw-Q selected action minus the deterministic best-candidate representative, compute true candidate-bank regret, DeltaU and DeltaActorDistance. Positive penalty contrast is directionally favorable only when regret exceeds the return tie band.
decision_facing_denominators: Report all positive-regret states and the unambiguous-best subset separately; keep zero/near-zero regret, ambiguous best, and tied signal counts. Never choose the best representative using U or actor-distance.
aggregation: Equal weights for episode/state summaries; report overall, both batches, each query time, and all eight batch-time strata. Compare marginal and partial correlations on their common-defined subset too.
magnitude_descriptives: Within-state centered RMS divided by raw RMS for U and Q1; norm of U remaining after linear actor-distance projection relative to centered U norm. These describe action differentiation, not efficacy.

frozen_selectors_for_event_precision_onl.raw_q: Reuse saved raw-Q score rule and verify selected index

fixed_selector_scope: Reconstruct only the already locked three settings on development data to count decision disagreements and estimate variance; no new settings, sweep, winner choice, or use of confirmation outcomes
uncertainty: Descriptive summaries only; no additional bootstrap, significance test, or confirmatory decision in this exploratory audit

precision_planning.effect_units: Discounted continuation-return units of BCA minus the fixed actor-distance control
precision_planning.target_scope: Illustrative fixed effect targets, not selected practical requirements or authorization for more samples
precision_planning.variance_estimate: For each query time, sample variance of the 32 saved paired episode differences pooled across two development batches; average the four variances for equal allocation
precision_planning.assumptions: Normal approximation, fixed equal allocation over four times, future independent episodes from the same distribution and checkpoint, development variance treated as known; sparse decision changes make estimates unstable
precision_planning.zero_variance_rule: Report not estimable from zero observed variance; never recommend zero samples

next_step_rule: Report evidence of mechanism weakness separately from wide uncertainty. Any method revision uses development only and requires a newly locked plan and fresh data; preserve the completed inconclusive confirmation.
